tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Reads a page of this site as markdown.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Lists pages on this site with their route, title and description.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Searches the full content of this site and returns the best matching pages with their route, title and description.

tools.name: analyze_robots_txt
tools.description: Fetch and parse the robots.txt of a site: rules per user agent, sitemap directives, syntax errors, and whether the file exists at all.

tools.name: check_meta_tags
tools.description: Read the head metadata of a URL: title, language, every meta tag (description, robots, Open Graph, Twitter), canonical and hreflang links, and the JSON-LD block count.

tools.name: convert_html_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert a web page (by URL) or a raw HTML string to Markdown, optionally keeping only the main content without navigation and footer.

tools.name: debug_social_share
tools.description: Check how a URL renders as a share card on social platforms and in chat apps: Open Graph and Twitter Card tags, the resolved image, and a warning for each missing or invalid tag.

tools.name: diagnose_url
tools.description: Audit one public URL for search and AI answers in a single call: returns a 0 to 100 score, a grade, and findings ranked by severity, each with the fix, covering indexability, meta tags, Schema.org, social cards, sitemap and robots.txt.

tools.name: get_module_setup
tools.description: Get the install command, installation guide and docs navigation for one Nuxt SEO module.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: List the Nuxt SEO modules with their npm package, docs link, latest version, GitHub stars and downloads in the last 30 days.

tools.name: validate_schema
tools.description: Find and validate the Schema.org structured data (JSON-LD and Microdata) on a URL: each detected type with its errors and warnings for rich results.

tools.name: validate_sitemap
tools.description: Validate the XML of a sitemap or sitemap index you pass in: URL count, duplicates, invalid URLs and dates, and protocol errors.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_meta_tags, debug_social_share, diagnose_url · Private data: analyze_robots_txt · Public sink: debug_social_share.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_meta_tags, debug_social_share, diagnose_url · Private data: analyze_robots_txt · Public sink: debug_social_share

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
